svg.aria-label: Kunal Taneja on Anmol: Anmol is a cool-headed guy who can manage a big team at such a young age. Started working at a young age. I worked with Anmol on multiple products from scratch at MathonGo for a good 1.5 years. Highly recommend Anmol for management, consulting and product roles.
